body:
MAINLINE-020 complete as an estimate. The pinned lead has 3498.47 kg of Be faces, not the brief’s 2100 kg. Own arithmetic reproduces SF 0.650412 and the 5% payload line; capacity remains 34.96% below demand.

Optimistic bonded seams plus both face/core films total 968.20 kg, replacing the 216.43 kg allowance and leaving payload -507.30 kg. Thin-sheet maximum size and grade prices remain UNKNOWN; published stock limits and explicit planning scenarios are separated. Current gauge tolerance and post-form properties materially affect the result.

K13D2U is the best inherited Be-free fallback: SF 0.54147 at identical geometry, or 0.61865 after resizing its published design to the same mass budget. AlBeMet contains 62 wt% Be.

Ground a weighed/load-tested joint/core panel and a supplier-confirmed thin-sheet specification with post-form mechanical data first. All material inputs remain QUESTIONABLE; unverified panel/joint capabilities are PROJECTION. Eight evidence needs remain open; no certification.

One simjob calculation completed, five checks passed, reservation released, scope inactive. Files and source evidence are pinned. The brief names no successor: stop and file, then robotics sends the next job.
